title: SIDESTORY: HERE A PEOPLE SOWS RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: HERE A PEOPLE SOWS RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Here A People Sows event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Agricultural Plate] & [City Core] & [Far Side of the Great River]
[Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau] by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Wanqing], Dahuang Tianshi Institute Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Sky Pole, etc.
[Shennong Market]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Sky Pole by clearing event stages and completing [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau]. Sky Pole can be used to redeem items from [Shennong Market].
REWARDS: Wanqing's token, Dahuang Tianshi Institute Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Shu, Zuo Le, Grain Buds, and Wanqing will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be available in [Side Story] from July 17, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Tons of Sunshine for Wanqing
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Paper Wing for Enforcer
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – SHENNONG TEMPLE FAIR & DAHUANG TIANSHI INSTITUTE
DETAILS: The two furniture sets will be available again during the event.
Shennong Temple Fair
HOW TO OBTAIN: Limited-time sale at the Store: July 3, 2025, 10:00 – July 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Dahuang Tianshi Institute
HOW TO OBTAIN: Here A People Sows event rewards and redeemable (pieces) Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces):
